description: Files a bug report or feature request when the user asks to report something. Confirm the title and body with the user before filing. Passing backtest_id attaches that backtest's spec so the issue can be reproduced.

backtest_id.description: The result this is about, if any.

body.description: What was expected, what happened, and any spec involved. Write it from the user's report, not from your own summary of it.

category.description: Omit it and it will be inferred from the text.

title.description: One line naming the problem or request.

name: submit_feedback
